Container.Name: ShellGuard
Container.Overview: 🛡️ ShellGuard is a zero-knowledge, self-hostable secrets vault designed for the Human-Agent ecosystem. Your secrets are encrypted client-side with ShellCryption©™ (AES-GCM-256) before they ever leave your browser — the server stores only opaque ciphertext in SQLite. Issue scoped LobsterKeys©™ to sovereign AI agents with granular read/write/edit/delete permissions, protected by SQLCipher metadata-at-rest encryption and an append-only audit trail.

Config.Name: Database Location
Config.Description: Location of the ShellGuard SQLite databases (db.sqlite + audit.sqlite)

Config.Name: Web GUI
Config.Description: The Default Port for the Web GUI

Config.Name: DB Encryption Key
Config.Description: OPTIONAL but strongly recommended in production. SQLCipher key encrypting database metadata at rest (secrets are always client-side encrypted regardless). Generate one with: openssl rand -base64 32. Changing it after first start requires re-keying the database.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Linux Group ID for file permissions

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Linux User ID for file permissions

Config.Name: Trust Proxy
Config.Description: Set to 'true' if running behind a reverse proxy (Nginx, Traefik, etc.)
